question: If θ is an acute angle and tan θ + cot θ = 2, then find the value of tan³ θ + cot³ θ + 6tan³ θ cot² θ.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If **tan θ + cot θ = 2**, this condition is only satisfied when **tan θ = 1** and **cot θ = 1** (since θ = 45°).

Substitute **tan θ = 1** and **cot θ = 1** in the required expression:

Expression = 1³ + 1³ + 6 × 1³ × 1²

Expression = 1 + 1 + 6 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8fc21ce1f77e8eb80d753ad4c647fd8528087ee31707968acf70d02c4e058ec.png] 

**Given:** tan θ + cot θ = 2

**Formula Used:** cot θ = 1/tan θ and (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

⇒ tan θ + 1/tan θ = 2

⇒ tan² θ + 1 = 2 tan θ

⇒ tan² θ − 2 tan θ + 1 = 0

⇒ (tan θ − 1)² = 0

⇒ tan θ = 1

⇒ cot θ = 1/1 = 1

Now, calculate: tan³ θ + cot³ θ + 6tan³ θ cot² θ

⇒ (1)³ + (1)³ + 6(1)³(1)²

⇒ 1 + 1 + 6 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Trig Identities

tan θ × cot θ = 1. Similarly, sin θ × cosec θ = 1 and cos θ × sec θ = 1.

Special Case for x + 1/x

If x + 1/x = 2, then xⁿ + 1/xⁿ is always 2 for any positive integer n.

Standard Trig Values

For θ = 45°, tan 45° = 1 and cot 45° = 1. This is the only acute angle satisfying tan θ + cot θ = 2.</p
